query: Which actors worked on which highly rated (>9.0) drama TV series released after 2025 and what alternative titles were used in France?
sql_query: SELECT p.name, t.primary_title, r.rating, a.title AS french_title FROM people p JOIN crew c ON p.person_id = c.person_id JOIN titles t ON c.title_id = t.title_id JOIN episodes e ON t.title_id = e.show_title_id JOIN ratings r ON t.title_id = r.title_id JOIN akas a ON t.title_id = a.title_id WHERE t.genres LIKE '%Drama%' AND t.premiered > 2025 AND r.rating >= 9.0 AND a.region = 'FR'
